target.title: fix(plugins): honor empty document extractor scope
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Document extractor resolution did not consistently honor an explicit empty plugin scope. With `onlyPluginIds: []`, the runtime could still expand an operator allowlist or bundled contract fallback and load document extractor plugins.

## Why This Change Was Made

An explicit empty scope means the caller selected no plugin ids. This change short-circuits document extractor resolution for that scope before allowlist or bundled-contract expansion.

## User Impact

Callers can safely request document extractors for an empty plugin scope and receive no extractors, including when `plugins.allow` contains `document-extract`.

## Evidence

- Changed `src/plugins/document-extractors.runtime.ts`.
- Added regressions in `src/plugins/document-extractors.runtime.test.ts` for empty scope with and without an operator plugin allowlist.
- Live open-PR conflict scan found no exact overlap on these touched files; #103176 is broad but does not touch these files.

## Proof

- Rebased cleanly onto `upstream/main` at `fbcb7812cb`.
- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/document-extractors.runtime.test.ts`
- `git diff --check upstream/main..HEAD`
- Earlier path-scoped check: `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --timed -- src/plugins/document-extractors.runtime.ts src/plugins/document-extractors.runtime.test.ts`
- Claude autoreview clean after Codex autoreview was blocked by local OpenAI API 401.
